intro.text: A cousin of Slowswift, who lent him and his brother Troalin to Vin as men he trusted.

items.text: With his brother Troalin, was lent to Vin by their cousin Slowswift when she asked him for two men he trusted. At a ball the pair helped her avoid being watched, hiding two of Aradan Yomen's spies she had knocked unconscious.
